name: Candy Apple Orchard
description: In 871 W. South Slope Road, ID, Candy Apple Orchard grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
